FUNDWATCH -- EXPLANATION REQUEST

To: Kalahandi Public Works Department
Agency ID: agy_0053
Risk Score: 100 -- Critical Red Flag
Date: 2026-09-11

Subject: Request for explanation regarding unusual expenditure pattern

FundWatch has identified a deviation from this agency's established spending baseline.

Detected observations:
- Spending velocity changed by +794% relative to this agency's own baseline
- Historical monthly baseline: Rs 1,940,037
- Current monthly expenditure: Rs 19,590,608
- 3 work(s) contributed to this month's disbursement
- Category most affected: Public Amenities
- Baseline violated: Distribution spread relative to this agency's own IQR fence

Clarification requested: Please provide an explanation and supporting documentation for the above expenditure pattern.

Response deadline: 2026-09-18

This notice reflects a statistical deviation only. It is not a finding of wrongdoing.

agency_response.text: Three drainage and street-lighting works reached financial completion in the same reporting month, which is why disbursement is concentrated here. Completion certificates and geo-tagged photographs are attached.

mp_verification.notes: Site visit confirmed all three works are physically complete.

resolution.notes: Explanation and MP verification are consistent with the observed spending pattern. Closing case.
